title: Product-address Mirror vocabulary with collision views
hypothesis: With 4096 logical tokens addressed by only 1024 product-key pairs, one per-token Mirror angle over the two shared sub-key vectors will resolve the four-way collisions with accuracy within 0.02 of native two-weight Hash Embeddings, beat scalar collision codes by at least 0.05, and use no more than 0.80x native importance-vector bytes.
physical_object: two 32-row shared product-key component tables of 16D vectors
mirror_coordinate: one Givens angle per token, selecting a functional mixture of the pair of shared component vectors
logical_multiplicity: four logical tokens per discrete product address, 4096 total tokens from 1024 q×r pairs

model.labels: token_id//1024, exactly four classes per colliding product address
model.product_address_rule: q=token_id%32, r=(token_id//32)%32; address pairs are deterministic, repeated by four collision groups and shared by all methods

controls: independent full token embedding table upper control
pure product-key composition by adding the two selected shared vectors, no per-token code
product-key shared vectors plus one scalar gain per token on their sum
native Hash Embeddings: two learned importance weights per token on the same selected vectors
Mirror: one per-token Givens angle mixing the same selected vectors
development_gate_before_fresh: For both seeds, Mirror test accuracy within 0.02 of native two-weight Hash Embeddings; at least 0.05 above scalar gain; actual payload <=0.80x native importance-vector payload; and no collision-group accuracy more than 0.02 below native. Report decoded-vector uniqueness; it is descriptive and not an independent pass gate. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds meet quality/bytes/collision gates with exact loaded-payload replay; report token-code bytes, collision-group metrics, actual payload, operator MACs and throughput.
failure_gate: Any registered development gate misses in either seed; fresh stays unopened.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload
paid_objects: full embeddings or shared sub-key tables
product address rule and collision metadata

boundaries: synthetic token classification with four labels determined by product-address collision group
all methods use same fixed deterministic q/r addresses and samples per seed
product address count is not logical function count; per-token task quality is decisive
fixed update evidence is not a capacity claim
fresh seeds stay sealed until all development gates pass
